requirements.title: 每根已收盘bar的因果状态
requirements.requirement: 状态只使用截至bar收盘的可得行情；首批不使用未来标签更新编码器。后续若单独立项预测，未来标签可用于监督但不得倒灌输入或自由生成。
requirements.acceptance: 未来扰动/截断不改已有状态，训练后权重也要检查。

requirements.title: 行情信息压缩，而非拟合几条规则
requirements.requirement: 优先保留价格路径、局部形态和有用成交/持仓内容，支持当前描述与后续复用；允许有损，不要求100%影线还原，不按纯K线未来能力删信息。
requirements.acceptance: 分开当前字段、近中远历史、活动、困难样本和冻结用途；图形像不像不作唯一验收。

requirements.title: bar状态与序列状态的关系明确
requirements.requirement: 声明每个状态H_t的实际可见区间、分辨率、归一预热与运行记忆；z_t=E(H_t)可作该历史的序列表示。内部token或短前缀不得冒称同等完整历史。固定128滚动是旧实例，不再限制新架构。
requirements.acceptance: 同物理端点/上下文评价；短前缀冷启动、完整滚动与长期记忆分开。

requirements.title: 价格与数据处理可追溯
requirements.requirement: 以真实合约和时间区间处理，不拼连续主力；价格锚点/尺度、全部预热依赖、缺失活动、分区跨度及train-only统计明确。
requirements.acceptance: 每轮协议绑定原始数据和统计来源；数据窗口/标签和缓存核对；没有独立复算的部分注明。

requirements.title: 状态可复用，可支持分类/趋势/波动等用途
requirements.requirement: 当前主验收之一：冻结embedding验证多种只依赖过去的行情描述/复用，匹配简单统计/PCA/原始输入与读头机会；不把某一规则拟合当全部目标。
requirements.acceptance: 同权重、同读取机会及事前门槛；历史状态描述不等于未来收益或开仓建议。

requirements.title: 保留未来逐bar外推方向
requirements.requirement: 方向保留而非首批前置：以后可由z、公开元信息及当时可得舆情/市场因子共同预测。真实新bar刷新与自由概率递推分开；真实未来embedding目标仍是E(H_(t+h))，内部u不得冒充。
requirements.acceptance: 未来用途单独验收并检查z、因子、融合和同信息原历史增益；当前历史/状态交付不依赖预测通过，未评价不得标失败。

requirements.title: 研究必须可归因、可证伪并逐步收敛
requirements.requirement: 固定来源、对照、预算、目标、选择和停止条件；失败配方不无限加轮数，不将保留研究模型称全局最优。
requirements.acceptance: 每轮只回答编号问题，记录有限结论、取舍和停止决定；最终独立留出另验。

requirements.title: 高效、可恢复的AutoDL交付
requirements.requirement: 本地只做合成测试/CPU数据与报告核验；真实模型在AutoDL；codex/babel-next准备推送；成功失败均导出到/root/autodl-tmp/download。
requirements.acceptance: 可运行时一次给完整启动/恢复/导出命令；同批必要对照，资源预算明确，不删除来源来过预检。

requirements.title: 每轮更新计划并按六方面复查
requirements.requirement: 写代码前声明编号；每个tar识别、复核、更新结论和队列；完成代码/计划都复查目标、架构、损失训练、验证及数据工程。
requirements.acceptance: 持久项目规则、逐项台账和追加事件；不把未验证标完成，不丢旧假设。

decision_unit.followup_conditions: 能改变决定的新证据、明确未识别因素、锁预算/判据；不为凑次数补验

decision_unit.bug_fix_exception: 必要错误修复不能因达到次数上限跳过；按范围和成本另记
decision_unit.multiple_comparisons: 事先锁主比较和选择顺序，必要时处理多重比较；不得事后挑最有利对照。数据/目标版本变化须共同桥接或明确新基线。

decision_outcomes.invalid_implementation: 暂停依赖，列受影响事实/结论/决策和最小修复集合；修复验证并核销结论后结束，与模型升级无关
decision_outcomes.valid_negative: 结束当前配方，保留负结果，转预设分叉，不改阈值/挑种子/无限加轮
decision_outcomes.inconclusive: 报差异范围和缺口；有界补验能解决才补，否则保留现版本、结束比较
decision_outcomes.tradeoff: 仅事前用途允许代价才列限定候选，不临时删不利需求
decision_outcomes.positive: 预定确认/留出/成本验证；已在本批完成不重做；冻结版本完整离机交付，转下一能力
decision_outcomes.overclaim_only: 撤回/收窄解释、更新依赖决定；没有数值训练错误则不新增训练

features.normalization: per-token same-period prior64-valid-return RMS with train-fitted floor and cold fallback; full warmup support counted; train-only field/period scale
features.warmup_audit_resolution: 64 contiguous qualified pre-current close returns require65 boundary closes; no skip across unknown gaps; calendar-qualified session breaks explicit

input.artificial_flags_current: zero in both current clean arms

relation.signed_gap_contract: nonnegative gaps on legal edges; if full matrix evaluated use sign(x)*log1p(abs(x)), no log1p of raw negative gaps

decoder.anchor_boundary: a=0 for query ending t, not scored; no true neighbor or per-query true sigma
decoder.query_phase: calendar ordinal within the past block, chronological j=0..15; current phase=(0,0). Lookup uses same prelocked calendar both arms.

matrix.structure: common relation/first Value backbone, h768 and direct FiLM
common backbone, fixed160+learned608, same FiLM then block adjustment
matrix.E_and_D_loss: L_clean on physically adjusted predictions; no gradient to observed facts

current_plan.comparison_scope: One comparison: full memory allocation + consistent readout. Shared backbone, coordinate phase and clean-only objective; no component, multiscale or superiority claim without experiments.

loss.P3_gradients: Price I-UU.T on complete blocks, physical-simplex and OI-boundary derivatives piecewise; losses only on preselected weighted queries and true adjacency. Invalid/current direct.

sampling.rho: uniform eligible product -> uniform contract -> uniform nonempty year-month -> uniform endpoint
sampling.query_estimator: sample by fixed w then plain mean, no extra w
sampling.current_queries: all legal intervals ending exactly at t, max4
sampling.adjacent: additional actual legal same-period neighbor predictions, never truth; validity fixed before sampling
sampling.evaluation: all declared legal intervals at fixed endpoints, separately current/age/view/field

mask.future_reentry: Any new masked experiment must remove all target dependencies from features, summary, masks and decoder-side information.

conditional_design.question: On one fixed state architecture, does adding masked historical completion improve clean-history retention and the frozen uses?
conditional_design.precondition: A residual/local-readback deficit on development data and sufficient visible context after masking; independent version, own frozen protocol and budget.
conditional_design.reference: Same fixed state architecture, mask-eligible endpoints, common initialization and clean supervision; clean loss only.
conditional_design.combined: Two views at one endpoint: full H and separately masked H. Reuse the same E and D in both forwards. Joint loss = L_clean + weight * L_mask, one combined backward and optimizer step.

source_mask.sampling: Uniform legal unordered nonoverlapping pairs of continuous segments within qualified trading sessions, strictly before t; keep the current anchor visible.

conditional_design.targets: 16 hidden past 1-minute intervals, equal across prequalified targets. Price/shape/activity weights as current_plan.loss.past_groups, valid terms fixed before sampling; truth enters loss only.
conditional_design.dependency_closure: Apply mask to raw-minute dependencies before deriving views. Propagate to affected OHLCV/OI aggregates, preceding-close links, rolling scales, flags and readable metadata. Fixed train fallback where required. Recompute P3 facts from masked visible input only: invalid block = four zeros and flag 0, direct readout. Counterfactual hidden-value changes under fixed visible history/mask/eligibility preserve masked input, flags, summaries and decoder metadata.
conditional_design.decision: Assess improvement in complete-input history fidelity with near-shape, activity and frozen-description protections; report frozen-order performance, masked error and actual extra compute separately. Sign comparison criteria before any independent run.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: 5% linear warmup then cosine to10%peak; one scheduler step per optimizer update
optimizer.precision: uniform BF16 only if device/numeric qualified; critical targets/metrics sufficient precision
optimizer.limits: AdamW decoupled parameter shrinkage not global optimum guarantee; record g_task dot actual_delta_theta alongside gradient cosines, with first-order/remainder limits
optimizer.decay_groups: matrices and learned embeddings decay; biases, norm and alpha scalars no decay
optimizer.gradient_accumulation: same effective endpoints and weighting, one optimizer update after accumulation; clip encoder and head separately

split_proposal.qualification: current: all input/warmup/historical-query support within assigned partition; no future60 requirement. Later forecast uses separately locked label-support inventory; no train/stat/pretrain final holdout.

matched: raw observations, total state FP32 words, query metadata and use-head side information
relation-first-value backbone and shared parameter initialization
clean endpoints/queries/loss, paired seeds, N updates/effective batch
standardization, selection opportunity and frozen-use labels
not_matched: P3 deterministic facts vs learned coordinates
mandatory within-block expansion/projection cost, actual gradient paths
fairness.claim: paired whole allocation/readout comparison, not matched FLOPs

history_evaluation.primary: deployed direct P2 vs deployed adjusted P3: whole-system fidelity
history_evaluation.R: final decoder, weighted half standardized relative-close MSE and half adjacent-return MSE; full eligible queries
history_evaluation.conditional: Trigger only on development data when both paired seeds meet the predeclared relative R gain and the overall U or any family exceeds its protected degradation. Then four frozen states each fit one fresh direct D256 with common protocol, at most four; report separately. No final holdout trigger.
history_evaluation.coherence: same physical parent-child complete partitions on clean observed history; no latent equality or extra unobserved minute targets
history_evaluation.R_perp: mean ||(I-UU.T)(a_hat-a)||^2/(14*s_price_period^2) on common valid blocks only; average blocks within valid view, views within endpoint, then renormalize rho over endpoints with support. Coverage and invalids separately, all in R.
history_evaluation.conditional_seed_scope: Check R per paired seed; for U use the release seed 42 paired comparison at the prespecified guard thresholds.

boundary_support: qualified full calendar support, no unexpected-gap concatenation
current_description.eligibility: same complete-label subset for all representations, discrepancy from history inventory disclosed
current_description.evaluation: mean18 standardized MSE plus natural-unit and per-target/horizon results
not_claimed: independent semantic discovery merely by fitting functions of reconstructed history
current_description.representations: four neural states, PCA768, same160+PCA608, raw same-information input; width128, 18 outputs
current_description.primary: U applies only to the defined 18 observed descriptors

head_optimizer_defaults.name: AdamW
head_optimizer_defaults.input_normalization: Fitted only on training frozen-cache input separately for each downstream representation; it must not overwrite the deployed history decoder interface.
head_optimizer_defaults.frozen_meaning: Optimizer/release card is not yet signed. During downstream fits the encoder is always frozen.

acceptance.absolute_utility: must fix physical errors/current-description tolerances using qualification samples and declared usage before candidate scores; remains open
acceptance.zero_denominators: predeclared absolute handling, no unstable ratio claims
acceptance.reference: matched P2 for the new design; numerical proposals not released
acceptance.incremental_claim: After absolute quality, upgrade and protections: R_perp below matched summary+PCA608 (system-level comparison); natural order BA above P2, same-summary PCA608, summary only and direction rule; same frozen probe on full-summary collisions ranks order above 0.5. Both paired seeds support direction and joint market-block bounds; inadequate natural or constructed support leaves the corresponding claim open.
acceptance.uncertainty: 95% simultaneous paired block max-t bounds for upgrade/claim family, preserving contemporaneous products and fixed seeds; block size and twice that size; inadequate supports/SE -> inconclusive, V13 open.
acceptance.upgrade_estimator: Release seed 42 relative R point gain at least .05 with simultaneous lower bound above zero and protected degradation simultaneous upper bounds within the caps; paired seed 43 direction confirmation. If only P3 meets all absolute deployment criteria it may be delivered for its qualified use separately from a comparative or incremental claim.

block_memory.slot_order: Enumerate exchange-calendar slots strictly ending before t from most recent; reserve maxima per view, do not extend the original observed caps (which include current); group consecutively. Chronological j=0..15 within group. Never compact missing slots.
block_memory.eligibility: Same contract, same qualified units, all 16 observed within shared input, reversible price/volume/OI features, 15 known consecutive same-period boundary-close links. Qualified calendar breaks and prescribed short session-tail intervals explicit. Current intervals always direct.
block_memory.invalid: Four zero coordinates plus mask 0; all independently eligible observed targets remain in R and clean loss; report qualified fraction under fixed query measure per view, product, time and endpoint.
block_memory.calculation: Recover relative log close path by setting first close locally to zero and accumulating 15 observed gap + body log returns. Both columns have zero sum. Recover physical V/OI from only shared inputs and train constants. Raw-source oracle is qualification only.
block_memory.price_adjust: For fixed valid block U, preliminary p, stored c, return p + U(c-U.T p). Squared improvement for the same p under exact c equals squared coefficient error; no implied SmoothL1/R/U improvement across learned models.
block_memory.volume_adjust: Invert stored S. If S=0 return zeros; otherwise Euclidean projection of preliminary physical volumes to nonnegative sum S: max(v-tau,0). Partial zeros allowed.
block_memory.oi_adjust: Delta inverse from z. Let p0,p1 be preliminary physical first open OI, last close OI. x=max(0,-Delta,(p0+p1-Delta)/2); endpoints x,x+Delta; other OI unchanged.
block_memory.read_contract: Always expand the same calendar block for a valid constrained query, discard unrequested outputs from loss; compute current boundaries separately and return raw head on invalid blocks. Aggregate OHLC only on exact nested physical supports for diagnosis, no hard equality across all resolutions.
block_memory.float_contract: Serialize raw c1,c2,log1p(S),asinh(Delta/s),valid flag as FP32. Set all five to zero on an invalid block. The FiLM conditioning copy scales four valid values by train-only period means and population SD floored at 1e-6, then forces invalids to zero and keeps mask. A view with no valid train block is excluded from fact calibration/eligibility for both arms and reported. Deterministic projection always uses the raw state, without global LN. Lock numerical tolerances in physical units before scores.
block_memory.OI_scale: Per period max(1 physical contract unit, median nonzero absolute Delta among valid training blocks); all-zero eligible group falls back to 1. Only comparable qualified volumes/OI in contracts.
block_memory.duration_weighting: Equal ordinal slot weights including calendar-accepted short final session bars, not equal minute-duration weights.

linear_controls.pca: Train-only PCA on frozen flattened common canonical-slot numeric, visibility and time features; train-only centering/scaling/imputation, deployment dimension includes all sample-dependent coordinates. Two PCA models or equivalent nested top components with counted cost.
linear_controls.calibration: Each PCA comparator has one family of train-only per-target/scheduled-slot masked ridge preliminary readouts of seven fields; normalized positive training weights sum to one; unpenalized intercept, lambda .01 on standardized inputs/targets; geometry/nonnegativity as for learned direct head. Same-summary comparator then uses the P3 block projection. Count actual subproblems and cost.
aggregate_diagnostics: true vs aggregate of predicted finer observed bars
discrepancy direct vs aggregate in common physical units on exact ordered child covers
linear_controls.feature_design: Slot-ordered same information available to both encoders. Training-only transforms and target masks.

order_probe.label: First maximum close before first minimum close is +1; reverse is -1; first occurrence breaks repeated extrema; all-flat undefined and counted; complete eligible 1m support only.
order_probe.fit: Train-only standardization constant -> 0, class mass 1/2 each, rho within class, sum weights=1, intercept unpenalized, lambda=.01; sign threshold 0, tie +1. Freeze before research and independent confirmation.
order_probe.rule: Positive end-minus-start close predicts low first (-1), negative predicts high first (+1); zero uses train-majority and ties +1.
order_probe.score: BA=mean class recall plus stratification by net return and realized vol, flat rates and class counts; task held out of encoder training, ridge uses training labels. Baselines paired on same support.
order_probe.matched_pairs: Preselect qualified endpoints independent of model scores; at most the first eligible adjacent interior pair per endpoint in a common constant-basis quarter and coarse interval. Construct integer-tick opposite-extremum-order paths on same context and schedule; accept only fully legal pairs with flipped 37-close label, identical full serialized 160 prefix and identical all coarse OHLCV/OI. Recompute full feature/warmup inputs; report supported endpoints and rejection reasons. Existing frozen probe, high-first scored higher=1, tie=.5, reverse=0. Any deterministic function of equal summaries ties. Report paired simultaneous-market-block interval and compare to .5 independent of the natural BA test. No extra fitting.
order_probe.pair_construction: Earliest eligible adjacent pair in the most recent 37 one-minute closes, both in the same uniform basis quarter and with successor in same 5/15/60 parents. All three consecutive trading minutes observed active. Use max(other 35 closes)+one valid tick and min(other 35)-one valid tick, in opposite orders; recompute opens from prior closes and H/L from O/C for affected three minutes, other data and V/OI fixed. Enforce known tick/market limits and qualified support; skip unknowns. Reject on unequal 160 serialized coordinates, unequal parent observations or same order labels. At most one pair/endpoint.

bounded_checks.scope: Arithmetic only; train-era convenience sample, no model weights, no full data qualification or independent holdout use.

source_sample.selection: 2022 named c2209/rb2210/cu2209, every calendar date in each file; day sessions start 09:00 and 13:30; offsets 0,16,32; 16 exact minute starts, finite positive closes and nonnegative V/OI, no activity/performance selection. No adopted historical session certification.
source_sample.numerator_denominator: sum block squared U.T(log close - block mean) / sum squared centered log close; contribution of fixed features on these files, not R, returns, explained market variance or trained-model fidelity.

order_blind_controls.definition: Ratio of expected energies, pooled sums before taking ratio. Preserve each real block's 15 signed increments and net displacement; uniform within-block permutation. With population increment mean mu, variance v, E[x_i*x_j]=i*j*mu^2 + v*(15*min(i,j)-i*j)/14. iid zero-mean homogeneous reference K_ij=sigma^2 min(i,j), J=I-11.T/16. No inference of market-specific order or significance.
order_blind_controls.independent_reproduction: Second implementation searched sorted Arrow timestamps, verified each of the three raw SHA-256 values against the archived inventory, and built E[dd.T] from distinct diagonal and off-diagonal increment products before cumulative summation. Both pooled ratios agreed within 1e-12 relative tolerance.

synthetic.protocol: NumPy PCG64 20261126, 2048x16 independent normal target .03 and preliminary .04; volume and signed OI projected in raw units. Collision j=5,6 have +/-0.01 log-close shocks then permuted inside the same quarter and 5m bar; other closes and all activity fixed. No neural execution.

permutation_formula.checks: all permutations of five unequal signed increments against the closed second moment

four_view_collision.support: Synthetic continuous-session calendar, integer ticks; end minute t=4802; otherwise 10000 ticks, swap closes 10001 and 9999 at t-11 and t-10; open previous close, H/L envelop O/C; V=1, OI=25 constant.
four_view_collision.interpretation: Only deterministic statistics and order labels verified, no actual neural state constructed or decoded.

targets: past price path, adjacent change, shape and activity
current shape and activity for legal bars ending exactly at t
active_pretraining.one_update: Pool legal queries, weight past and current then backpropagate once per effective batch. Clip E and D separately and make one optimizer update; P3 physical readout uses within-state facts, without trainable summary parameters.

trainable_modules: order ridge readout fitted in closed form

findings.disposition: 新增3.11的非交换结合聚合、共同支持与clean一致性诊断；软/硬协调不未经验证自动入loss。

findings.finding: 端点无未来与内部三角mask混写；相对t坐标、遮挡模式不保证内部token可跨端点复用。
findings.disposition: 明确端点因果的充分条件、内部mask只是选择；保留目前mask，不声称双向历史必泄漏。

findings.finding: 未明确极值依赖须按潜在支持隐藏，若按argmax是否变化决定mask会透露隐藏内容。

findings.finding: 64个有效收益若跳过异常缺口或漏算边界，会改变支持；头侧信息范围易扩张。
findings.disposition: 64连续合格收益需要65个边界收盘；未知缺口fallback；禁止每query真实尺度作为旁路。

findings.finding: 旧日期与新分辨率不自动产生独立数据；窗口长度也不保证相关块独立。
findings.disposition: 最终留出须核查原始内容暴露及源模型使用、时区/边界；块长考虑超出窗口的共同依赖。

findings.finding: 当前描述是已有历史的函数，单靠拟合这些量不证明模型比直接计算有用。
findings.disposition: 区分压缩/复用证据与实际应用增值；完整成本/失效界面；新任务另验。

findings.finding: 768维、Value凸混合、信息论与距离公式均有条件，不能证明充分性或结构优越。

findings.finding: 有当前实体保护，但上下影只列分项，没有明确不可补偿退化线。
